notes: Abell 1689 / VCC (Binggeli+1985); 2096 confirmed members. Three subclusters: A (M87), B (M49), C (NGC4261). Many infalling HI-stripped spirals in outer zone (ram-pressure). M87 jet drives AGN heating of ICM.

members.name: M87
members.notes: BCG; 6.5B M☉ BH; relativistic jet; X-ray cavities; radio lobes

members.name: M49
members.notes: Virgo B subcluster BCG; brightest Virgo galaxy

members.name: M90
members.notes: Falling into cluster; ram-pressure stripped; blue-shifted (approaching)

members.name: NGC 4261
members.notes: Virgo C subcluster BCG; FR I radio jets
